cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(Robot_Dogzilla)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(QT_QML_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Gui Qml)
qt_standard_project_setup(REQUIRES 6.5)

qt_add_library(Robot_Dogzilla)
qt_add_qml_module(Robot_Dogzilla
    URI "Dogzilla"
    VERSION 1.0
    RESOURCE_PREFIX "/qt/qml"
#    OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/Dogzilla" # same as the default
    QML_FILES
        "Dogzilla.qml"
    SOURCES
        "DogzillaControlBase.h"
        "DogzillaControlBase.cpp"
        "DogzillaControl.h"
        "DogzillaControl.cpp"
    RESOURCES
        "dogzilla_joints.json"
)

target_link_libraries(Robot_Dogzilla PUBLIC Qt6::Gui)
add_subdirectory(Generated)

set(ROBOT_Dogzilla_PLUGIN
